research_sources.purpose: Official character design research; compact proportions and coordinated costume masses.
Official pixel character research; small-scale silhouette and clear costume shapes.

prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a FRESH ORIGINAL extremely appealing cute CHIBI PIXEL ART boy hero for a sunny forest action RPG. Design-study conclusions: appeal comes from coherent rounded silhouette, very compact little body, simple face, a few large coordinated clothing shapes and natural stance. Do not copy any existing game character. This is a new design proposal retaining identity cues chestnut brown hair, blue eyes, red scarf, blue outfit and silver sword. Critical proportion: whole figure including hair is only 1.65 heads tall. Head and hair form ONE ROUND COMPACT silhouette, ONLY THREE soft chunky hair tufts, no massive tall spiky anime mane. Short side-swept warm chestnut fringe, visible forehead. Face: rounded soft cheeks, tiny chin, simple medium blue eyes with one white square glint each, short relaxed eyebrows not thick black angry wedges, small confident cheerful smile. Adorable unmistakably BOYISH tiny adventurer, brave and bright, no eyelashes, no makeup, no baby pacifier. Body is very short and round, tiny little forearms, mitten-like fists and stubby short legs. Natural charming stance: feet only shoulder width, one foot slightly forward, not broad adult fighting squat. Outfit designed as a clear cohesive costume: short rounded cobalt blue adventurer vest with a WIDE simple warm ivory front panel and ONE small dark fastening; ivory short sleeves; dark navy shorts; tiny tan ankle boots with ivory soles, no big folded cuffs; narrow simple dark brown waist belt with small subtle clasp. Bright vermilion scarf wraps snugly around neck and ONE broad short scarf tail flowing gently LEFT. No random pouches, armor, badges, hanging tabs, gold clothing trim, chest straps, intricate seams or buttons. Outfit should feel like a thoughtfully designed collectible little forest explorer, not generic elaborate old RPG armor or plain contemporary denim jacket. Right hand holds an elegant silver sword with small warm gold guard forward RIGHT, slight up angle, blade about 85 percent entire standing figure height, keep sword thin and readable with full tip visible. Free left little fist relaxed. Camera full-body 3/4 facing right with gentle overhead game view, complete boots and hair visible. Rendering: very CLEAR deliberate UNIFORM SQUARE PIXEL GRID with effective figure 48 pixels tall, enlarged nearest-neighbor appearance, sharp square stepped contour, 3 shade clusters per material, bright warm modern cheerful palette. No thin jagged high-resolution microdetails, no smooth airbrush, no gradients, no oil paint or 3D. Single complete hero positioned left of center to leave right space for sword. TRUE FULLY TRANSPARENT ALPHA outside silhouette, absolutely NO GLOW, NO AURA, NO HALO, NO ground shadow, NO backdrop, no checkerboard pattern, no text, no labels, no comparison figures. Clean production-style isolated sprite concept. Prioritize cuteness, coherent clothing and small-size readability.
generation_inputs: Text only; no third-party game images uploaded to generator.
notes: User explicitly requested internet design research. Search/opened official sources and image search; design conclusions are subjective interpretation. New original candidate retains project palette/identity, not direct game character adaptation. Generation still has visible outer glow and finer detail than 48px target; no claim of clean production alpha, exact resolution or calibrated sword. Gameplay unchanged.
